Name: Stardrop Enhancement
Author: chuyb
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardrop Enhancement is a  SMAPI mod that upgrades the Stardrop. Now, every single Stardrop you consume will permanently enhance your physical abilities by granting fully customizable bonuses to Max Health, Defense, and Speed![/color][/size]

[b]Configuration Guide (config.json):[/b]
[code]
{
  "ExtraHealthPerStardrop": 3,  
  "ExtraDefensePerStardrop": 1,  
  "ExtraSpeedPerStardrop": 0,2
}[/code][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]• [b]Stardew Valley[/b] (Version 1.6.0 or higher)
• [b]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/b] [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and Pathoschild for maintaining the exceptional SMAPI ecosystem. Feel free to leave an endorsement if you enjoy the mod![/color][/size]
